**# PR Description: Remove Operating Room Field from Monarch Case Info**

**## References (Jira/Figma/Confluence/others)**

- https://aurisrobotics.atlassian.net/browse/PFM-446

**---**

**## Detailed Details of the Changes:**

**### Problem Statement**

Monarch users were seeing an Operating Room (OR) field in the Case Info panel when viewing case details. However, the OR field is not included in the Case Edit UI for Monarch cases and is always displayed as empty, creating confusion and a poor user experience.

**### Solution**

Modified the Case Details Info Section component to conditionally hide the Operating Room field specifically for Monarch case data sources, ensuring consistency with the Case Edit UI behavior.

**### Changes Made**

**#### Component Updates (`apps/polyphonic/app/cases/[id]/_components/CaseDetailsInfoSection/CaseDetailsInfoSection.tsx`)**

- Updated the facility information grid to check for `isMonarchCase` in addition to existing conditions

- Operating Room field now only displays when:

  - The case is NOT in read-only mode (`!isReadOnly`)

  - AND the case source is NOT Monarch (`!isMonarchCase`)

****Before:****

```tsx

{!isReadOnly && !isMonarchCase && (

  <Grid item xs={6}>

    <CaseInfoBlock

      data-test-id="jnj-case-info-operating-room"

      label={t('operatingRoom')}

      content={surgery.facility?.operatingRoom}

    />

  </Grid>

)}

```

**#### Test Coverage (`apps/polyphonic/app/cases/[id]/_components/CaseDetailsInfoSection/__tests__/CaseDetailsInfoSection.test.tsx`)**

- Enhanced the CaseInfoBlock mock to properly forward `data-test-id` prop

- Added comprehensive test suite: ****"Operating Room visibility with isMonarchCase"****

  - ✅ Test: Verifies OR field is ****hidden**** when displaying a Monarch case

  - ✅ Test: Verifies OR field is ****displayed**** for non-Monarch cases (e.g., Ottava)

**---**

**## Acceptance Criteria Met**

- ✅ ****Given**** a Monarch user accesses Cases and selects a case  

- ✅ ****When**** the Case Info panel is displayed  

- ✅ ****Then**** the Operating Room field is NOT shown  

- ✅ Non-Monarch cases (Ottava, etc.) still display the OR field correctly

**---**

**## Affected Apps (BIOMED/POLYPHONIC/CORE)**

- ****POLYPHONIC**** ✓

**---**

**## Affected Pages/Packages**

- `apps/polyphonic/app/cases/[id]/_components/CaseDetailsInfoSection/`

  - Component: `CaseDetailsInfoSection.tsx`

  - Tests: `__tests__/CaseDetailsInfoSection.test.tsx`

**---**

**## Verification Steps**

**### Manual Testing**

1. Log in as a Monarch user

2. Navigate to ****Cases**** page

3. Select any Monarch case

4. Verify ****Case Info**** panel appears without the "Operating Room" field

5. Log in as a non-Monarch user (or view Ottava case)

6. Verify the "Operating Room" field is visible

**### Automated Tests**

```bash

npm run test:ci:polyphonic -- CaseDetailsInfoSection.test.tsx

```

- All existing tests pass ✓

- New tests validate OR field visibility logic ✓

**### Coverage**

- Ensures backward compatibility for non-Monarch cases

- Proper conditional rendering for data source type
